notes.title: LOCALIZATION UPDATE
notes.notes:
[p][b]We are happy to announce the release of the localization update![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="mYl8X3y4dIU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Now you can play Keep Driving in the following languages:
English, German, French, Spanish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified) and Japanese!
It's been a lot of work to get this done, and we want to thank all translators, QA testers and programmer Juju Adams who helped us with a great localization system.

This update also adds some new content to the game (including a new ending). 

Thanks for everyone who's enjoyed and supported the game!
Cheers,
Christopher & Josef

Full patch notes follows:
[/p][p][b]LOCALIZATION:[/b]
- Added new languages to the game:[/p][p]	- German[/p][p]	- Swedish[/p][p]	- Spanish[/p][p]	- Portuguese (Brazilian)[/p][p]	- Chinese (Simplified)[/p][p]	- Japanese[/p][p]	- Ukrainian[/p][p]	- French[/p][p]	- Russian[/p][p](You can change language in the options menu)
[/p][p][b]NEW CONTENT:[/b][/p][p]- Added a new hitchhiker[/p][p]- Added a new ending[/p][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][p]- Fixed bug where the garage-screen could be seen behind the inventory screen when using the muscle car[/p][p]- Fixed bug where the shop in pubs/cafe wouldn't display correctly[/p][p]- Fixed weird audio bug "clicking-sound"[/p][p]- Fixed bug where if you got a black-out when in the music-menu, the music menu would be locked on the screen[/p][p]- Fixed bug where, if exiting the junkyard by walking out, the map would instantly close down when trying to open it.[/p][p]- Fixed bug where the little junkyard-avatar would be walking when you opened the junkyard[/p][p]- Fixed some typos[/p][p]- Fixed bug where if you couldn't afford paying at a hostel and used a gamepad, you would soft-lock yourself[/p][p]- Fixed several instances of formatting errors (i.e. displaying text such as §armor etc)[/p][p]- Fixed issue where the wrong tooltip would sometimes be displayed when hovering the legend-icons in the map[/p][p]- Working at night in the desert won't give you the cold status anymore[/p][p]- "music blasting" event-effect effect is now tied to stereo/subwoofer upgrade.[/p][p]- You will now lose the cold-status when day breaks in the desert[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.0.0e
notes.notes:
- Save issues

It has come to our attention that some players have experienced data loss following a crash. I have added an extra failsafe, when loading, to restore missing save-files if for any reason the save-file would disappear. From some research I've done it's probably related to an engine-problem where files that have been written to sometimes get deleted completely if the computer crashes while the game is running.
If any data-loss still appears to anyone after this update, please report it to us so we can look into it more.

To those who have experienced data-loss, I am very sorry. I will put up a guide on how to manipulate a save-file to add certain endings. This can obviously be used to cheat, but I think it's nice to have this for those who lost data.

On another note there have been reports on cloud-saved not working properly. Especially between steamdeck and PC. We've been notified that there have been some faults with the custom cloud-path setup on our end that created files in the home directory. That shouldn't have affected the cloud saves, but now the game won't create unnecessary folders at least.
Be sure to always wait for the cloud saves to finish uploading/downloading when switching between deck/pc.

There are more bugs that we are aware of that will be fixed in the upcoming bigger patch. Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Keep Driving Update

With help from programmer Juju Adams the game is now ready to be translated and we're aiming for August to release the localized patch. Thanks for your patience!

Languages planned for Localization patch are:
German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Ukrainian , Japanese, Chinese (Simplified) and Russian[/p][p]We plan to have a sale up when that patch drops as well, but maybe not as deep as the Summer Sale.[/p][p]
[b]New features:[/b][/p][p]- Added some new Traits[/p][p]- Added some new items[/p][p]- Added new junk-upgrades. You can find them at junkyards and abandoned cars.[/p][p]- Updated some car-sprays and added some more.[/p][p]- Added new Road events[/p][p]- Added new two new threat warnings:[/p][p]    [b]Clone:[/b] Instead of damaging you, creates a new threat of the same type[/p][p]    [b]Change:[/b] After attacking, randomize threat type.[/p][p]- Changed some details in the Mechanic's quest. Cheers,

notes.title: Keep Driving Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch notes for build 1.1.0.0:[/h2]

[h3]New content:[/h3]
- Added Gamepad support (works great on Steam Deck!)*
- Added Casino-minigame for El Cobra
- Added Junkyards. (You need to start a new game for them to show up)
- You can now visit El Cobra without any prerequisites. (You need to start a new game for this location to show up, unless you already have access to it)
- Added the option to refuel jerrycans at gas-stations
- Added a bunch of new cosmetic items!
- More side-stops appear even on later playthroughs now.
- Added option for borderless full-screen
- Added campsite-side stops (You need to start a new game for them to show up)
- At campsites you can rest for free and fully restore energy

[h3]Bug fixes and tweaks:[/h3]
- Fixed bug where you could get the cold status when sleeping in the desert, even if you had a sleeping bag or slept in a hostel
- Fixed bug where items outside trunk would be invisible when the upgrade-tab was active
- Fixed bug where hitchhikers would be invisible after returning to a destination with tow-truck or by calling parents
- Fixed a bug where explore-locations in cities could be loaded as forest-explorations
- Fixed an issue where some illegal actions could be made while in the road event tutorial
- Fixed a very rare crash that could happen during quite specific circumstances (had to do with rust-buildup on car during rain)
- Increased energy cost of skill: "Cub Scout"
- the Suspension-upgrade now removes car-bumping
- Fixed bug where the Bride's pickup-banter would overwrite other Hitchhiker's banter
- Fixed some typos

* If you play on Steam deck, make sure to [b]not[/b] lock your FPS for best possible performance.

We also want to thank all the 100 000+ people who bought the game! Thank you playing and writing messages to us and supporting the bands! It's our biggest game yet and we're so happy so many people are enjoying it. Here's a little trailer for the new content all recorded with gamepad:

[previewyoutube=YfELKTLjsvI;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers,
Y/CJ/Y

notes.title: 2025 Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey!
Keep Driving has been out now for close to 2 months and we're really happy with all the positive feedback and all the wonderful messages some of you've sent us. <3

I know a lot of people are wondering what the plans are, especially about localization and porting, so I thought I'd post a message to get you guys in the loop.

We have planned 4 updates during 2025, not including bug fixes and patches:
[list]
[*] [b]April[/b] - content and controller support
[*] [b]May[/b] - smaller content update
[*] [b]Late summer/early fall[/b] - localization
[*] [b]Late fall/early winter[/b] - consoles
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023475/f84fce282b7276d98ba6643770ca516446c7f3ce.png[/img]

One thing to keep in mind is that [u]nothing is set in stone[/u] with the dates and we still don't know exactly what consoles we are doing. Switch is most likely going to be included. Things like the junkyard or camping ground might be moved to the may update.

As for the [b]languages[/b], the ones we know we'll have are: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Russian and Ukrainian. These are based on sales, consoles, and steam demographics.

Lastly, as some of you know, we are a two person team (with Vile Hartman hired for the sound design) that have coded and drawn everything in the game from scratch. However, this year will be a bit different because of personal circumstances. So we will be working with the great Gamemaker guru Juju Adams for localization and porting. This is also why we won't be releasing many content updates and taking it a bit slower with the updates.

Keep Driving,
xo
Josef & Christopher
Y/CJ/Y


[i]PS. Take it easy everyone. Hopefully this year we will continue to see the game growing, solidifying itself in the tapestry of great indie games, with the message that life goes on, the big the small, the good the bad; life keeps on going. And how important it is to appreciate the fleeting beauty of the world, and the fleeting beauty people you stumble upon, and the fleeting beauty of now. Especially if you're young. It doesn't last forever.[/i]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
Another patch up (should be available shortly, it's already live on the test branch)! Thanks for all the feedback and bug-reports. If you encounter some serious bug please don't hesitate to write about it. Added some QOL-updates to the inventory this time around: The ability to move things to your extra-space form the right-click-menu and to rotate an item that you're holding by pressing the "R"-key.

Here are the patch notes:

- Fixed a rare crash for some players when loading a game in rain
- Muscle car's description now correctly says 3 passenger seats
- You can now rotate an item while holding it and pressing "R". This also works when holding an item from a shop!
- Fixed crash when trying to use a cd from the glovebox. (you can no longer use cds from there)
- When shift-clicking to buy something with the extra-space active, the item will move to the extra space instead of the trunk. (same with items outside of the trunk)
- Added "MOVE" as an option to the item-right-click-menu. This will swap an item to the extra-space (if you have any). If used from extra-space it will move the item back to the inventory.
- When using an item in the extra-space that spawns a "new" item (like baguette or jerry-cans) they will stay there.
- The dimensions of the roof-racks are now correct in the item-description
- No more raining in the desert

- Punk club is no longer in ALL cities (only the city specified in his quest)

notes.title: Keep Driving, the turn-based driving RPG about fighting tractors while playing smelly Tetris with pizzas, loo roll, and the occasional trumpet, finally has a full release date
notes.notes:
February 2025, a month that's famously not going to feature many big video game releases (to be fair, one of those has since been delayed), has just been revealed as the arrival point for another cool thing you might want to play. It's Keep Driving, the driving RPG thingy that has you fight stuff in turn-based fashion while accumulating stuff.

Read more

notes.title: Keep Driving Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it’s Josef and Christopher!

[h3]We’ve been waiting to make this announcement for a long time now: Keep Driving is officially launching on Thursday, February 6!!![/h3]

We’ve been making this game for years now and we never would’ve expected the support we’ve gotten. [b]After having over 100,000 people play our demo and gaining over 170,000 wishlists,[/b] we still can’t believe it. We’re nearly at the end of the road now, and we’re really grateful for all your excitement. Excited for you all to show up on launch week! Check out the new trailer, shows a lot of new things and the music is perfect (Wake Up by Holy Now).

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames]Twitter [/url]and join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord [/url]to keep up with our updates! If you enjoy what you’ve seen of the game, feel free to wishlist – there’s still time to do so before launch! Every single one means so much to our small indie team. It’s just us two, and it’s been a wild ride. :)  

[h3]See you for launch day soon![/h3]

[previewyoutube=nT5YZlFKDgA;full][/previewyoutube]
Cheers
Josef & Christopher
Y/CJ/Y
